members.name: key
members.doc: Stable identity. An item keeps its line across datasets, so switching morphs it.

members.name: label
members.doc: Name beside the start value, in the tooltip, and in the table.

types.name: SlopeChartProps
types.doc: Use a slope chart to show how several items changed between exactly two moments, and how their order changed.

members.name: label
members.doc: What is measured, such as "Conversion rate by channel". Names the chart for assistive technology.

members.name: startLabel
members.doc: Heading of the first column, such as "Q1".

members.name: endLabel
members.doc: Heading of the second column, such as "Q2".

members.name: formatChange
members.doc: Formats the change in the tooltip. Defaults to the difference in formatValue's terms.

members.name: height
members.doc: Plot height in pixels. Defaults to 44 pixels per item.

members.name: highlightKey
members.doc: The item drawn in the accent, such as the one the story is about.

members.name: activeKey
members.doc: Controlled item in focus. The others fade while one is in focus.

members.name: ranks
members.doc: Rank movement beside each end value.
